notes: The patch ensures that the proposal persistence block in stage_contact_update_from_memory is reachable by moving the proposal_payload construction and metadata assignment before the return statement in the else branch. This allows confirmed contact facts for existing contacts to be properly handled either through auto-application or explicit proposal.
patch_text:
--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py
+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py
@@ -100,10 +100,12 @@ def stage_contact_update_from_memory(
         "proposal_payload": proposal_payload,
         "target_contact_id": target_contact.id,
     }
-
+    proposal_payload["memory_sync_status"] = "ready"
+    proposal_payload["proposal_metadata"] = {
+        "memory_id": getattr(memory, "id", None),
+        "memory_category": metadata.get("category"),
+        "memory_fact": metadata.get("fact"),
+        "sensitive": bool(metadata.get("sensitive")),
+        "source_context": _MEMORY_PROPOSAL_SOURCE,
+    }
 
     # This block is now reachable and will handle the proposal persistence
     # for non-auto-applied contact updates.
